sourceIdentity: Detached worktree based on baseCommit; the exact changed runtime/test bytes are bound by sourceFiles. The containing Git commit supplies the resulting source identity.
cause: The adapter already recognized exact no-write SQLSTATE refusals, but the selection journal retained only the command. A fresh Candidates session restored result:null, losing the known refusal and its existing explanation. NOT_FOUND could not reconstruct that outcome.

negativeControl.testRuntime: Only the new regression test was present; journal and Candidates runtime were unchanged preimage bytes.

expectedAfterRestart.poruka: Prijava pokriva više ljudi nego što je još potrebno.

implementation: Keep the original account/Need storage key, immutable command, serialized native chain and five-second enqueue deadline.
Version 1 records remain valid and are not rewritten during reads. A proven refusal promotes only its exact existing command to version 2.
Version 2 stores only the existing allowlisted refusal code and canonical explanation. No candidate profile, mutable offer, note, location or newly authored UI text is added.
A retained sender cannot downgrade or resend a version 2 record. Explicit existing reset must retire the exact command before a new selection.
Cold loading restores the proven refusal into the existing UI state. The same read-only receipt RPC still runs; an exact authoritative receipt retains precedence.
Account/session/focus/deadline guards remain active at each asynchronous boundary. A late refusal cannot create a missing record or replace another command.

targetedAndAdjacent.durationScope: Local synthetic test process duration, not app, provider or native latency.

validation.dependencies: Existing exact package-lock dependencies prepared by the coordinator; temporary node_modules symlink is not part of the commit.
covered: Cold restart after real adapter OVERFILL/P0001, STALE_REVIEW_REQUIRED/P0001 and APPLICATION_PRICE_BASIS_REVIEW_REQUIRED/PT409 refusals preserves their existing text and reset action.
Legacy v1 and NOT_FOUND stay unknown; transport failures, missing SQLSTATE, SQLSTATE mismatch and idempotency-key collisions are never persisted as refusal.
Invalid schema, version, marker, code, arbitrary text and extra fields fail closed without erasure or RPC.
No downgrade/resend, immutable payload, existing refusal idempotency, explicit retirement, and no recreation by a stale result.
Logout, account change and same-account/new-session changes fence persistence; a late writer reply after focus or session replacement does not settle durable unknown state.
Failed and silent device writes keep current known refusal but do not invent persistence on restart.
Expired queued operations do not run; a late native refusal write remains serialized before clear and a newer command.
A matching authoritative completed Agreement receipt overrides a local refusal and retires the exact record using only the reader.
Existing selection receipt, pricing basis, ownership, editor recovery and application journal regressions.

independentReview.mode: read-only diff and actual harness checks
checks: Authoritative CONFIRMED receipt wins over local v2 without a writer.
A native v2 write followed by readback failure retains the known outcome and a fresh process reads the actually saved refusal.
A timed-out native refusal write cannot overtake a queued clear and newer save.

boundaries: The tests execute production TypeScript journal, adapter, actual route callbacks and existing recovery presentation. RPC, AsyncStorage, account state, native rendering and clock seams are controlled.
No new UI design, user text, SQL, DEV operation, package dependency, feature flag or CODEX modification.
No new full CI, APK, emulator, physical-phone force-stop, Android bridge or E2E claim; coordinator performs integrated CI separately.

No claim of atomicity across the server reply and device persistence. Process loss before the refusal is durably saved, or a device write failure, leaves the original v1 unknown request for read-only reconciliation.
An already issued native write may finish after ownership loss; it remains under the original account/Need key and serial queue. It cannot update another account or overtake a newer command.

The previous application parser rejects v2 rather than silently replaying it if an older binary is installed. Retain the updated reader when rolling back unrelated code; do not delete journals as a downgrade workaround.

The persisted refusal explanation is intentionally restricted to the current approved code/copy map. A future approved copy change requires explicit reader compatibility for stored v2 text rather than accepting arbitrary persisted text.
